title: The Long Shadow
hook: Stay in its shadow. Don't move.
synopsis: On the open salt flat there is nowhere to hide. Rook puts out every light and hides the dark train in the Hush's own long shadow.
note: The last train runs again tomorrow.
lines: The lamps are going out. It's behind us!
It's faster on the flat. Hold the bar!
No hills. No trees. Nowhere to hide!
Look! Its shadow. Long and black.
It looks for lights, not at its feet.
Slow now. Same speed as it.
Stay in the dark. Stay in it.
Oh no. Its shadow is moving!
It sees us! Lights on! Full steam!
Salt Town! Hot soup for everyone!
It will be back. Hold the bar.
